audience: pharmacists and drug-information researchers who check FDA drug labels on DailyMed

useCases.title: Find the label of a drug and its latest version
useCases.text: The AI searches labels by drug name and shows setid, title, version and publish date. It can first check the exact spelling of brand and generic names.

useCases.title: Read the full text of a drug label
useCases.text: The AI fetches the full label as XML for a setid. It can pull out indications, dosage, warnings, boxed warning and adverse reactions.

useCases.title: See how a label changed over time
useCases.text: The AI lists every published version of a label with its date. You see when the labeling was updated.

useCases.title: List package codes (NDC) and package sizes
useCases.text: The AI reads the NDC codes and packaging descriptions of a label. You see which package sizes and codes exist for a drug.

useCases.title: Check active ingredients and packaging images
useCases.text: The AI reads product names and active ingredients with their strength, and lists the product and packaging images of a label.

useCases.title: Find labels by NDC, RxCUI, UNII or application number
useCases.text: The AI searches labels with one of these codes, and can list RxCUIs or UNII codes to find the right one.
